## Lisbon Budget Trip Snapshot
A 4-day, walk-friendly Lisbon plan for **2 adults** focused on history, viewpoints, and local cafes, with **daily food + activities kept under €70 total**. I’ve assumed you’ll use a **24-hour transit pass or occasional metro/tram rides** and choose mostly free or low-cost sights.

## 4-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Daily Cost Plan
| Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | Est. Cost for 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Apr 10** | Baixa + Rossio walk; coffee and pastel de nata in a local cafe | Alfama lanes, Lisbon Cathedral area, Miradouro de Santa Luzia | Sunset at Miradouro da Senhora do Monte; casual dinner near Graça | **€58** |
| **Apr 11** | Tram/metro to Belém; Jerónimos exterior + riverside walk | Belém Tower area, Monument to the Discoveries, bakery stop | Back to central Lisbon; Chiado stroll and budget tapas | **€66** |
| **Apr 12** | Bairro Alto to Principe Real walk; viewpoint stops | São Jorge Castle area from outside, Alfama viewpoints, museum-free wander | Fado-style neighborhood dinner or simple tavern meal | **€69** |
| **Apr 13** | Parque das Nações waterfront walk; coffee by the river | Final shopping in Baixa/Chiado; last viewpoints and lunch | Easy departure evening; light snack if needed | **€52** |

## Day-by-Day Budget-Friendly Plan
### Day 1: Old Town Orientation
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Start in **Baixa/Rossio**, then walk to **Praça do Comércio** for a classic first look at the city.
- Afternoon: Explore **Alfama** on foot, with stops at **Lisbon Cathedral** and **Miradouro de Santa Luzia**.
- Evening: Catch sunset from **Miradouro da Senhora do Monte** and eat a simple local dinner nearby.

Food plan for 2:
- Coffee + pastries: €8–12
- Lunch at a casual cafe: €22–26
- Dinner at a tasca: €20–24

Estimated total:
- Transit: €0–8
- Food: €50–58
- Activities: €0–5
- **Daily total: €58**

### Day 2: Belém Classics
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Take public transit to **Belém** and walk the riverfront.
- Afternoon: See the **Jerónimos Monastery** exterior, **Belém Tower**, and **Monument to the Discoveries** area.
- Evening: Return to the center for a relaxed **Chiado** walk and a low-cost dinner.

Food plan for 2:
- Breakfast coffee and pastry: €8–12
- Lunch near Belém: €24–28
- Dinner in Chiado/Baixa: €22–26

Estimated total:
- Transit: €6–10
- Food: €54–66
- Activities: €0–4
- **Daily total: €66**

### Day 3: Viewpoints and Neighborhoods
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Walk **Bairro Alto** and **Principe Real** before it gets busy.
- Afternoon: Spend time around **São Jorge Castle** exterior areas and nearby viewpoints in **Alfama**.
- Evening: Choose a neighborhood tavern for dinner, then do one last viewpoint stop.

Food plan for 2:
- Breakfast in a cafe: €8–12
- Lunch at a simple restaurant: €22–26
- Dinner at a tavern: €26–31

Estimated total:
- Transit: €0–6
- Food: €56–69
- Activities: €0–6
- **Daily total: €69**

### Day 4: Riverside Farewell
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Walk the **Parque das Nações** waterfront for a calmer final day.
- Afternoon: Return to **Baixa/Chiado** for shopping, coffee, and any missed viewpoints.
- Evening: Keep it light with a snack or early meal before departure.

Food plan for 2:
- Breakfast: €8–12
- Lunch: €20–24
- Snack/light dinner: €10–16

Estimated total:
- Transit: €4–8
- Food: €38–52
- Activities: €0–2
- **Daily total: €52**

## Best Way to Keep Costs Low
- Use **walking for central neighborhoods**: Baixa, Chiado, Alfama, Bairro Alto.
- Use **public transit only for longer hops** like Belém and Parque das Nações.
- Prioritize **free viewpoints** and **church/cathedral exteriors** instead of paid attractions.
- Choose **tascas**, bakeries, and cafe lunches over sit-down tourist restaurants.
- Share one bigger meal per day and keep the other meals simple.

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Transit Planner](https://www.carris.pt/en/)
Action: [Button: Lisbon Visitor Info](https://www.visitlisboa.com/en)

## Sources

- Lisbon tourism guide: https://www.visitlisboa.com/en
